description: Open and flowing. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa sits in the lower-left of the living area facing the TV; a coffee table sits in front, with the TV against the left interior wall.. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (open two facing units). Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); households needing a home office (no desk or dedicated work room); roommates wanting separate private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: households needing a home office (no desk or dedicated work room)
